_doc: Canonical league constants for the Sunday Scaries weekly system. Hand-maintained + verified against the live Sleeper API on 2026-08-07. Anything marked _unverified must be confirmed before it is trusted in a decision.

roster._flex_note: RESOLVED 2026-08-24 to ONE FLEX. Andrew confirmed the league dropped back to a single FLEX (QB/RB/RB/WR/WR/TE/FLEX/SUPER_FLEX/DEF = 9 starters), matching the 'Season 2 Changes' doc. The pre-draft API pull that had shown 2 FLEX did not hold; the completed 15-round draft (9 starters + 6 bench = 15) confirms it. Re-verify against GET /league each run in case the commissioner changes the setting mid-season.

scoring.format_summary: half-PPR + 0.5 per first down (rush and rec)

def._def_note: Commissioner flagged 2025 DEF scoring as overpowered/buggy and said 'Fix Def scoring (TBD)'. The yardage-allowed tier stack above IS still present in the 2026 config and is the likely source of the inflation (a DEF can bank 5 + 10 = 15 pts before making a single play). NOT confirmed fixed as of 2026-08-07. Do not trust historical DEF totals.

strategic_notes: 0.5/first-down rewards chain-movers: slot WRs, check-down RBs, possession TEs. Nudge those up vs standard half-PPR ADP.
Superflex + only 10 teams means ~15-18 QBs rostered leaguewide; QB scarcity is real but a 2nd starter-quality QB covers SUPER_FLEX.

waivers._resolution: RESOLVED 2026-08-07. league.settings.waiver_type == 1 (Sleeper: 0=rolling, 1=reverse standings, 2=FAAB). The waiver_budget:100 field is Sleeper boilerplate present on every league and is NOT in use here. Confirmed empirically: 2025 transactions show settings.priority integers on waiver claims and waiver_budget:[] on every single transaction — i.e. priority was consumed, no bids were placed.
waivers._day_note: AMBIGUOUS - DO NOT TREAT AS RESOLVED. Sleeper reports waiver_day_of_week=2, waiver_clear_days=2, daily_waivers=0, daily_waivers_hour=0. Reading 0=Sunday..6=Saturday makes day 2 = TUESDAY, and hour 0 makes that TUESDAY 00:00 ET - i.e. a Tuesday-morning run would already be too late. Reading it as 'Tuesday night rolling into Wednesday 00:00 ET' makes the Tuesday run correct. These two readings give OPPOSITE answers about whether the whole Tuesday premise works, and nothing in the payload settles it. waiver_day_name below is set to Wednesday on the second reading and is NOT verified. CONFIRM WITH THE COMMISSIONER, or observe when a real claim actually processes, before relying on run timing. Until then submit claims by MONDAY night to be safe under either reading.
waivers.run_deadline_guidance: UNVERIFIED. Safe under both readings: submit claims by Monday night ET. If processing is confirmed to be Wednesday 00:00 ET, Tuesday 18:00 ET is fine.
waivers.priority_rule: Worst record gets priority 1. Using a claim sends that team to the back of the queue (rolling).
waivers._evidence_summary: 2025 week 8, n=33 transactions: 0 with a non-empty waiver_budget; 3 with settings.priority. Model contention as priority ordering, not bid sizing.

keeper_rules.cost_rule: First time a player is kept: the round he was drafted last year. Each consecutive year kept after that: N-1, one round cheaper in NUMBER than last year's cost (i.e. more expensive in value). An escalated cost that reaches R1 is valid but is that player's LAST eligible keeper year (there is no R0). Corrected 2026-08-24 from the earlier incorrect flat/carry-forward model.
keeper_rules.undrafted_pickup_rule: A player added via free agency or waivers who was never drafted costs a 12th-round pick to keep.
keeper_rules._deadline_note: Sleeper metadata carries keeper_deadline:'1' with no readable date. _unverified — confirm with commissioner.
keeper_rules.strategic_note: Every in-season waiver add carries hidden 2027 keeper equity at a 12th-round price. A claimed breakout is worth far more than identical production from a player drafted in round 3.

season_phases.name: small_sample
season_phases.default_posture: Judge opportunity (snaps, routes, target share), not fantasy points. Do not cut good players for one-week wonders. Waiver claims should target opportunity changes, not box scores.

season_phases.name: trade_window
season_phases.default_posture: Most aggressive phase for the trade board. Rivals have formed strong opinions off small samples — buy low and sell high now.

season_phases.name: playoff_positioning
season_phases.default_posture: Weight weeks 15-17 schedules over season-long averages. Trade deadline is week 13 — a hard wall for consolidation moves.

season_phases.name: playoffs
season_phases.default_posture: Streaming and matchup optimisation dominate. If elimination is likely, flip the entire objective to keeper-equity accumulation for 2027.

calendar._playoff_note: playoff_week_start=15 and playoff_teams=6 confirmed from Sleeper. Week 14 is the last regular-season week; the plan doc's 'weeks 14-17 are the playoffs' is loose phrasing — week 14 is the last chance to secure a seed.

open_questions.question: Is FLEX really 2 slots for 2026?
open_questions.answer: ONE FLEX. Andrew confirmed 2026-08-24 the league runs QB/RB/RB/WR/WR/TE/FLEX/SUPER_FLEX/DEF = 9 starters; the completed 15-round draft confirms it. The pre-draft API pull that had shown 2 FLEX did not hold.

open_questions.question: Priority or FAAB?
open_questions.answer: waiver_type=1 = reverse-standings rolling priority. Verified empirically against a full real week (2025 wk8, 33 transactions, saved as raw/transactions_2025_week8.json): ZERO non-empty waiver_budget fields, and 3 claims stamped with settings.priority (0,1,2). Sleeper stamps settings.priority only on claims that consumed priority. Not FAAB.

open_questions.question: Exact processing clock time for waivers?
open_questions.impact: Determines how late the Tuesday run can fire. Assume Tuesday 18:00 ET deadline until confirmed.

open_questions.answer: Filled 2026-09-10 in nfl_bye_weeks_2026.byes from cross-verified schedule research. Week 11 is a 6-team bye (ATL/CLE/GB/LAR/NE/SEA); week 12 has none.
